sdk_harness.note: Same 51 bounded SDK assertions plus four local-origin assertions; not additive independent coverage.

assurance_tests.note: Same exact copied assurance tests rerun in full-base environment. Overlapping coverage, not 107 additional unique tests.
assurance_tests.isolated_configuration: -I, PYTHONPATH removed, plugin autoload disabled, --noconftest, standalone config, owned external basetemp

initial_harness_failure.cause: Harness assumed local --find-links dependency would have direct_url.json; corrected only in separate full-base harness to verify installer-report file URL and SHA256.

prior_sdk_only_environment.interpretation: Prior voluntary subset environment had missing base dependencies; it was not a resolution/access/resource blocker. New full-base environment succeeds. Base dependencies are configuration/security/CLI packages; optional ML extras were not requested or installed.

local_contracts: Both environments use retained locally built codex-contracts wheel selected via --find-links, not registry-only assurance. Install report binds wheel URL/digest; find-links dependency has no direct_url.json.
limits: Observed base dependency metadata conformance and exercised SDK functions only; not all distribution features or optional extras.
No authenticated independence, G5, institutional acceptance, approval or activation.
Dependency advisory check is bounded known-advisory evidence, not proof of security.
retention: All commands, dependency reports/versions, failed and successful harnesses, logs and test outputs retained in owned package-changed namespace.
